home.title: Global view (public)
home.aumEvolutionHint: Total amount managed by the pool. Colored dots mark a deposit, withdrawal, or test adjustment — not trading performance, so they aren't confused with a gain/loss.
home.navEvolutionHint: Value of one pool share (AUM ÷ number of shares) — this is the pure trading performance metric. A deposit or withdrawal never changes it (the shares exchanged are calculated exactly at this NAV): only a winning or losing trade can move it up or down.
home.legalDisclaimer: This system manages third-party funds. The legal status of this activity must be clarified before any production use with real external clients.

client.ledgerFootnote: "Impact" is already net of fees (trading fees charged by the platforms used, then a 30% performance fee on gains, taken only above the highest NAV ever reached). The "Fees" column shows the total amount you would have been credited with additionally if no fees had been taken on this trade.

client.withdrawPendingHint: Stays pending during the anti-arbitrage delay before being actually sent.

manager.title: Manager area
manager.logTradeTitle: Log a trade / today's result (manual entry)
manager.logTradeHint: Entered trading fees are deducted before computing the result. A 30% performance fee is then taken on gains (net of trading fees) above the high-water mark, no fee otherwise.
manager.createTestClientHint: Creates a client account and immediately credits it with an initial deposit (bypassing the pending workflow), to observe the balance/shares for different amounts. Does not affect the NAV (assets and shares added proportionally, like a real deposit).
manager.adjustAumHint: Directly sets an AUM (and thus a NAV) to test scenarios. No fee is taken; also resets the high-water mark to this level (otherwise the next trade would retroactively charge the gap created by this adjustment). Not to be used in real production — every use is logged in the audit trail with the reason entered.
manager.resetAllHint: Permanently erases all clients, deposits, withdrawals, trades and fees, and resets the pool to zero (AUM $0, NAV 1). Your manager account is kept. Irreversible — for development use only.
manager.name: Name
manager.willLogYouOut: — will log you out of your current manager session
manager.resetConfirm: Erase ALL data (clients, deposits, withdrawals, trades, fees) and start from zero? This action is irreversible.
manager.tradingFeeHint: Spread, funding, execution fees charged by the platform(s) used — deducted before computing the % impact on AUM and thus before the performance fee.

emails.footer: Ledger Capital — this is an automated email, please do not reply.
emails.welcomeBody:
Hello {name},

Your account has been created. Before you can make a first deposit, complete your KYC verification from your client area.
emails.kycSubmittedBody:
Hello {name},

Your KYC submission has been received and is pending review by a manager. You'll be notified as soon as it's processed.
emails.depositSubmittedBody:
Hello {name},

Your deposit request of {amount} has been received and is pending confirmation by a manager.
emails.withdrawalSubmittedBody:
Hello {name},

Your withdrawal request of {amount} has been received and is being processed by a manager.
emails.depositApprovedBody:
Hello {name},

Your deposit of {amount} has been confirmed and added to the shared pool.
emails.withdrawalSentBody:
Hello {name},

Your withdrawal of {amount} has been sent.

Transaction reference: {txHash}
emails.withdrawalRejectedBody:
Hello {name},

Your withdrawal request of {amount} has been rejected, your shares have been restored.

Reason: {reason}
emails.kycApprovedBody:
Hello {name},

Your identity verification has been approved. You can now request withdrawals.

Hello {name},

Your identity verification has been rejected.
